scope: Store foundation for desired Claude selection, stopped-profile CWD extension and two admitted authentication helpers
behavior: A structurally valid exact-target ready receipt with positively stale canonical generation/expiry permits one desired-selection commit pending renewal. The receipt is retained, and Runtime/admission continue to refuse consumption. Malformed, unreadable or conflicting authority still refuses selection.

Established profiles can gain bounded exact CWD membership only after positive writer exclusion. Existing native account/trust fields survive MCP-map merging; config and its directory settle before registry publication, including retry after uncertain rename. A semantically unchanged complete merge avoids rewriting config.

Begin and Replace share a locked bounded existing-intent census. At most two unresolved helper admissions coexist across handles. Terminal labels or absent PIDs do not free a slot; exact positive settlement and empty payload do.
